actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
The title of the measure was amended. Agreed to without objection.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 393 - 0 (Roll no. 209). (text: CR H3934-3935)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 393 - 0 (Roll no. 209). (text: CR H3934-3935)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3975-3976)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 8428.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3934-3936)
Mr. Gill (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 40 - 0.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform.

committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Applies to federal employees in financial, grant management, and program oversight roles across all agencies, plus participating state and local personnel.
dimensions.evidence: any employee serving as a program administrator, program officer, financial administrator or manager, disbursement certifying official... auditing official, grants manager

dimensions.assessment: Mandates recurring training courses and certification tracking for covered employees every two years.
dimensions.evidence: completes the Program... not less frequently than once every 2 years thereafter.

dimensions.assessment: Requires interagency development and reporting without specifying direct funding appropriations for the training rollout.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury may make the Program available at no cost to employees or contractors of a State

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 5 of the United States Code to create a government-wide training curriculum, certification tracking system, and reporting requirement.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 41 of title 5, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Creates a permanent training mandate requiring completion every two years alongside ongoing annual reporting to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: not less frequently than once every 2 years thereafter

missing_information: Total number of federal, state, and local employees required or eligible to take the training
Total administrative cost to implement and maintain the certification system
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a mandatory federal antifraud and improper payment prevention training program for federal employees in oversight roles, with optional access for state, local, and tribal governments.
